title: Software, systems and enterprise — Architecture processes
evidence: iso.org listing loaded live via search: "ISO/IEC/IEEE 42020:2019 - Software, systems and enterprise — Architecture processes" at iso.org/standard/68982.html. AI Standards Hub mirror (aistandardshub.org/ai-standards/software-systems-and-enterprise-architecture-processes/) loaded live confirms: "Publication Year: 2019 (published 23 Jul 2019)", developed by BSI/IEC under ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 7. IEEE Xplore record (ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8767004) and INCOSE guide corroborate the six defined processes: governance, management, conceptualization, evaluation, elaboration, enablement — 45 activities.
note: The direct process companion to the corpus's anchor standard 42010: specifies the governance/management/evaluation/elaboration processes that architecture description (42010) and architecture obligations sit inside. This IS the D3 governance process standard; fills the standards-side gap the critic panel flagged as the pass's clearest omission.

title: Software, systems and enterprise — Architecture evaluation framework
evidence: iso.org listing loaded live via search: "ISO/IEC/IEEE 42030:2019 - Software, systems and enterprise — Architecture evaluation framework" at iso.org/standard/73436.html. AI Standards Hub mirror loaded live confirms publication 24 Jul 2019, developed by BSI/IEEE under ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 7. iso.org OBP scope text (via search) states it "extends and complements ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010" — 42010 addresses how to describe architectures, 42030 addresses how to systematically evaluate them, with mappings to ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 and 12207 life-cycle processes.
note: The standardised counterpart to ATAM/CBAM, which the corpus holds only in SEI form. Generalises SAAM/ATAM/CBAM-style evaluation into an ISO process framework — fills requirements x governance and design x governance.
